title: Spread a supplied comparison of normalized affine fan opens
statement: Let $T$ be a sharp monoidal space and $h:T\to F$, $k:T\to G$ local maps to fine fans [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup]. Fix $t\in T$, affine opens $L\ni h(t)$ and $K\ni k(t)$ with coordinates $P=\mathcal P_{F,h(t)}$, $Q=\mathcal P_{G,k(t)}$ [lem-trf-affine-fan-hom-universal]. Assume $P$ is fine and both coordinates are normalized so the germ of the pulled-back canonical section equals the open-inclusion stalk map. Suppose a monoid map $\alpha:P\to Q$ and a SUPPLIED isomorphism $e:K\simeq L$ satisfy $k_t\alpha=h_t$ and $e^*\rho_L=\rho_K\alpha$. Then on some open neighborhood $U$ of $t$ contained in $h^{-1}L\cap k^{-1}K$ there are restricted factorizations $a:U\to L$, $b:U\to K$, with their full sheafed-space triangles commuting and $a=b\mathbin{\gg}e$. The lemma does not construct alpha or e; alpha need not be invertible.

source.place: ILO VIII, proof of Theorem 3.3.15, printed p.109, common inverse image U and shrinking because the monoids are fine; Lemma 3.1.8(ii), printed p.99.

proof.text: Take V=h^{-1}(L) intersect k^{-1}(K), which contains t. Restrict the maps and factor through the opens. These factorizations exist for sheafed spaces by restricting their presheaf natural transformations; they are local because open inclusions identify stalks. Compose the h-factorization with the affine coordinates of L, and the k-factorization with e followed by the same coordinates.

Naturality of germs and the normalizations of the coordinates identify the two canonical P-section germs at t with h_t(p) and k_t(alpha(p)), transported to the stalk on V. The supplied section identity for e gives the second formula. The supplied equation k_t alpha=h_t makes them equal for all p. The target monoid P is fine and sharp (it is a fan stalk), so apply lem-trf-affine-fan-germ-rigidity. It gives an open of V about t on which the two full morphisms agree.

View this open as U in T, using that V is open. Restrict the two factorizations once more. Cancel the affine coordinate isomorphism of L in their equality to obtain a=b followed by e. Functorial restriction supplies both triangles. Since U is contained in V the two image containments hold. The trivial P case is included in the rigidity lemma and requires no generator choice.

theorem affine_open_germ_comparison
    (T : SheafedSpace CommMonCat.{u})
    (hT : ∀ x : T, IsSharp (stalk T.presheaf x))
    (F G : Fan.{u}) (h : T ⟶ F.space) (k : T ⟶ G.space)
    (hh : IsLocalMorphism h) (hk : IsLocalMorphism k) (t : T)
    (L : AffineOpen F.space (stalk F.space.presheaf (h.hom.base t)))
    (K : AffineOpen G.space (stalk G.space.presheaf (k.hom.base t)))
    (hL : h.hom.base t ∈ L.openSet) (hK : k.hom.base t ∈ K.openSet)
    (hf : IsFine (stalk F.space.presheaf (h.hom.base t)))
    (nL : ∀ p : stalk F.space.presheaf (h.hom.base t),
      germ (F.space.restrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf ⊤
          ⟨h.hom.base t, hL⟩ (by trivial) (affinePullback L.iso.hom p) =
        stalkMap (F.space.ofRestrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding) ⟨h.hom.base t, hL⟩ p)
    (nK : ∀ q : stalk G.space.presheaf (k.hom.base t),
      germ (G.space.restrict K.openSet.isOpenEmbedding).presheaf ⊤
          ⟨k.hom.base t, hK⟩ (by trivial) (affinePullback K.iso.hom q) =
        stalkMap (G.space.ofRestrict K.openSet.isOpenEmbedding) ⟨k.hom.base t, hK⟩ q)
    (α : stalk F.space.presheaf (h.hom.base t) →*
      stalk G.space.presheaf (k.hom.base t))
    (ha : (stalkMap k t).hom.comp α = (stalkMap h t).hom)
    (e : G.space.restrict K.openSet.isOpenEmbedding ≅
      F.space.restrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding)
    (he : (SheafedSpace.Γ.map e.hom.op).hom.comp (affinePullback L.iso.hom) =
      (affinePullback K.iso.hom).comp α) :
    ∃ U : Opens T, t ∈ U ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U, h.hom.base x ∈ L.openSet) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ U, k.hom.base x ∈ K.openSet) ∧
      ∃ (a : T.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding ⟶ F.space.restrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding)
        (b : T.restrict U.isOpenEmbedding ⟶ G.space.restrict K.openSet.isOpenEmbedding),
        a ≫ F.space.ofRestrict L.openSet.isOpenEmbedding =
          T.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ h ∧
        b ≫ G.space.ofRestrict K.openSet.isOpenEmbedding =
          T.ofRestrict U.isOpenEmbedding ≫ k ∧
        a = b ≫ e.hom
